text:
Maya: FYI started A/B canary for rwd-v9-int4 vs rwd-v9-fp16. Small traffic (5%) but seeing divergence on long-context doc-summarization slices. Posting quick numbers.
Arjun: ah ok — what's the divergence look like?
Maya: short summary metrics from last 2h
Maya: MRR | fp16 0.804 | int4 0.781 | delta -2.9%
Maya: hallucinations per 10k | fp16 0.08 | int4 0.12 | relative +50%
Maya: p50 latency | fp16 110ms | int4 86ms
Maya: p95 latency | fp16 420ms | int4 640ms (weird tail)
Lee: p95 up on int4 — could be kv-cache miss + longtoken recompilation, saw similar on staging
Arjun: any pattern by seqlen? slice it by >1800 tokens
Maya: yes — drift concentrated when doc length > 1800 and when request includes >1 code block or many inline citations
Maya: logs show frequent cache invalidation + re-embed fallback on int4 nodes (kv-miss spikes)
deploy-bot: Canary rwd-v9-int4 scaled to 6 nodes @1718349280 — autoscale event
Sam: got 3 user reports flagged as hallucinated citations, all from long docs in the last hour
Arjun: recommendation: trigger canary auto-fallback per policy. Our thresholds: hallucination rel >30% OR MRR drop >2% over rolling 30m -> rollback
Maya: current window exceeds both (halluc +50%, MRR -2.9%) — agree to rollback and run targeted shadow with kv-fix
Lee: I'll kick a rollback now, also capture debug traces and disable chunk-level cache on int4 nodes for a shadow pass
Maya: noted. After rollback we'll run a calibration job: per-layer scaling + kv-consistency test (nvllm-style), then a 1% shadow for 24h on the impacted slices
Sam: pls add a quick note to the canary ticket about impacted slices and user reports
Maya: done. tagging @Arjun @Lee @Sam for postmortem
Arjun: thanks. keep thread updated — we need to tune the automatic gate to catch this long-tail earlier :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Patch rollback started @1718349350
